study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective longitudinal study
exposure: Method of assessing exclusive breastfeeding: 24-hour recall vs. since birth method
cohort: 284 participants from the Postpartum Mothers Mobile Study (PMOMS)
finding: The 24-hour recall method consistently yielded higher estimates of exclusive breastfeeding rates compared to the since birth method, highlighting the significant impact of assessment method on reported breastfeeding practices.
